# CannyMinds Technology Solutions

> Enterprise software development, AI automation, and digital transformation solutions provider.

## About

CannyMinds Technology Solutions is an ISO-certified IT solutions company founded in 2020. We specialize in enterprise content management, HR & payroll systems, document digitization, workforce productivity monitoring, and AI-powered automation. We serve clients globally from offices in India, USA, and Nigeria.

## Certifications

- ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management)
- ISO 15489:2016 (Records Management)
- ISO 22716:2007 (GMP Cosmetics)
- FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance

## Products

- [CannyECM](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/enterprise-content-management): Enterprise content management software for document organization, version control, workflow automation, and compliance.
- [CannyHR](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/hr-management): HR and payroll management system with attendance tracking, leave management, and statutory compliance.
- [CannyScan](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/scanning-solution): Document scanning and digitization solution for converting physical records to searchable digital formats.
- [CannyTrack](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/tracking-system): Consent-based employee productivity monitoring with activity tracking, screenshots, and data loss prevention.
- [Physical Records Management](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/physical-records-management): End-to-end physical records storage, tracking, retrieval, and destruction services.
- [Canny eBMR](https://www.cannymindstech.com/product/ebmr): Electronic batch manufacturing records for pharmaceutical production compliance.

## Industry Solutions

- [Manufacturing](https://www.cannymindstech.com/solutions/manufacturing): Shop floor automation, batch record digitization, FMCG transformation.
- [Healthcare](https://www.cannymindstech.com/solutions/healthcare): Clinical workflows, patient records, compliance audit, document digitization.
- [Pharmaceutical](https://www.cannymindstech.com/solutions/pharmaceutical): GMP compliance, batch records, quality management, regulatory documentation.
- [Finance](https://www.cannymindstech.com/solutions/finance): Banking technology, insurance technology, governance & compliance.
- [Professional Services](https://www.cannymindstech.com/solutions/professional-services): Audit firms, legal document management.
